title: Marsh Plaza Details
description: From the plaza, find two different shapes in the stonework on Marsh Chapel’s front. Pick the detail you’d put on a passport stamp. Best in daylight.

title: BU Beach River View
description: Walk behind Marsh Chapel to BU Beach. Find a public spot with a view toward the Charles and pick your favorite angle. Best in daylight.

title: Pavement Bagel Break
description: At Pavement across from Marsh Chapel, pick a bagel or coffee from the counter menu and share your go-to combo.

title: Kenmore Sign Hunt
description: From the public sidewalk in Kenmore Square, find a spot where the Citgo sign and the streetscape fit in the same photo. Best in daylight.

title: Fenway From the Sidewalk
description: Walk to the corner of Jersey Street and Brookline Avenue and find a Fenway Park sign you’d use to introduce Boston to a friend. Street access can change on game days.

title: Fenway Pastry Pick
description: At Tatte on Boylston, choose a pastry from the case and note which one you’d tell a friend to try.

title: Find the Library Courtyard
description: Enter the Central Library and find the courtyard. Look for an arch that frames the courtyard and choose your favorite viewpoint.

title: Commonwealth Ave Mall Walk
description: Start on the tree-lined mall at Dartmouth Street. Walk one block and find a detail you’d normally miss from the sidewalk.

title: Newbury Coffee Break
description: Stop at Thinking Cup on Newbury Street and pick a coffee, tea, or small pastry that fits your budget.

title: Frog Pond Lookout
description: Find Frog Pond in Boston Common and look back across the park from the pond edge. Check in from the path.

title: Frame the Lagoon
description: Walk to the Public Garden footbridge and find a view that fits both the lagoon and the Back Bay skyline.

title: Coffee by the Common
description: At Thinking Cup on Tremont Street, pick up a coffee or tea and find a spot overlooking Boston Common.

title: City Hall Plaza Shapes
description: From the plaza, choose a spot where you can see the contrast between the brick ground and City Hall’s concrete facade. Parts of the plaza can close for events.

title: Spot the Faneuil Hall Weathervane
description: From the outdoor plaza, look up and find the grasshopper weather vane. Share one detail you noticed on the building. Best in daylight.

title: Quincy Market Snack Mission
description: Walk the food colonnade and choose one counter snack. Compare the posted prices before you order. Vendors keep their own hours.

title: Find a New England Snack
description: At Boston Public Market, read two vendor signs and choose a small snack from a New England maker. Vendors keep their own hours.

title: Greenway to the North End
description: Cross to the North End Parks and find a bench or a view along the Greenway. Pick a meeting spot you’d send to a friend. Best in daylight.

title: Step Inside the Paul Revere House
description: Do a self-guided museum visit and find a detail that tells you how a Boston household used the space. Open until 5:15 PM from mid-April through October.

title: Find Johnston Gate
description: From the public sidewalk on Massachusetts Avenue, look for the brick and iron details of Harvard Yard’s Johnston Gate. Best in daylight.

title: Look Up at the Art Museums
description: Visit the Harvard Art Museums on Quincy Street. From the courtyard, look up at the glass roof, then pick one artwork you’d come back to see.

title: Harvard Square Pastry Pick
description: Visit Tatte at 1288 Massachusetts Avenue and choose the pastry you’d recommend to a friend.

title: Catch Graffiti Alley in Color
description: Find the alley at 565–567 Massachusetts Avenue. Choose a color that ties together two pieces on the walls. Best in daylight.

title: Browse a Central Square Shelf
description: Stop at the Central Square Branch at 45 Pearl Street. Find a book whose title would make a good name for a T quest.

title: Coffee at 1369
description: Visit 1369 Coffee House at 757 Massachusetts Avenue and pick a coffee or tea you’d order again.

title: Look Up at Chinatown Gate
description: From the sidewalk at the Beach Street gate, look for the roof colors and decorative details above the entrance. Best in daylight.

title: Find a Quiet Corner at Chin Park
description: Just beyond the Chinatown gate, find the bamboo and pick a place where you’d pause before heading back to the T. Best in daylight.

title: Pick a Dim Sum Plate
description: Visit Winsor Dim Sum Café at 10 Tyler Street. Compare the radish cakes with a dumpling plate and choose what to try.

title: Cross the BU Bridge
description: Walk onto the BU Bridge sidewalk and look downriver. Find the Back Bay skyline and pick the boat, building, or bridge you’d point out to a friend. Best in daylight.

title: Stroll the Back Bay Fens
description: Follow the paths south of Kenmore into the Back Bay Fens. Find a bench by the water and note one plant or bird you spotted on the way. Best in daylight.

title: Trinity in the Glass
description: Stand in Copley Square and find the spot where Trinity Church shows up reflected in the glass tower behind it. Best in daylight.

title: Find the Marathon Finish Line
description: On Boylston Street in front of the Central Library, find the painted Boston Marathon finish line. Check in from the sidewalk, not the street.

title: Walk the Granary Burying Ground
description: Enter the Granary Burying Ground on Tremont Street and find the markers for Paul Revere and Samuel Adams. Stay on the paths. Closes at dusk in winter.

title: Spot the Gold Dome
description: Walk up the Common toward Beacon Street and find a view of the State House’s gold dome framed by the trees. Best in daylight.

title: Find the Lion and Unicorn
description: Walk to the Old State House at Washington and State Streets. Look up for the lion and unicorn on the roofline and the balcony above the street. Best in daylight.

title: Walk Through the Glass Towers
description: Walk the path through the six glass towers of the New England Holocaust Memorial on Congress Street. Take it slowly and read one inscription.

title: Shop the Haymarket Pushcarts
description: On Friday or Saturday, walk the open-air produce stalls on Blackstone Street. Compare two vendors’ prices on the same fruit and pick one to buy. Stalls run roughly dawn to dusk.

title: Look Up at Old North
description: Walk through the North End to Salem Street and find the steeple of Old North Church, where the two lanterns hung in 1775. Best in daylight.

title: Pick a Pastry on Hanover Street
description: Walk to Mike’s Pastry on Hanover Street, scan the case, and choose one pastry to try. Lines are shortest on weekday mornings.

title: Meet the John Harvard Statue
description: Walk into Harvard Yard and find the John Harvard statue in front of University Hall. Read the inscription on the base. Best in daylight.

title: See the Glass Flowers
description: Visit the Harvard Museum of Natural History on Oxford Street and find the Glass Flowers gallery. Pick the model you’d swear was a real plant.

title: Find Cambridge City Hall
description: Walk up Massachusetts Avenue to Cambridge City Hall at 795 Mass Ave. Find the clock tower and one detail in the stonework. Best in daylight.

title: Get a Scoop at Toscanini’s
description: Walk to Toscanini’s on Main Street and choose one flavor to try. Ask for a taste of anything unfamiliar first.

title: Spot the Theater Marquees
description: Walk up Washington Street to the Boston Opera House and find its marquee. Count how many other theater signs you can see from the same spot. Best after dark.
